blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Learnable Representations (LRs) can fit parametric families of functions to diverse kinds of signals. These emergent neural-native data formats are gathering interest in the scientific community due to their compactness, resolution-agnosticism and amenability to direct neural processing. On the other hand, gigapixel images are becoming increasingly widespread across a variety of scientific, cultural, and industrial domains. In this paper, we present GigaBench, the first benchmark and experimental evaluation focused on deploying LRs with gigapixel imagery. GigaBench includes images collected, acquired, and synthetically rendered across diverse domains, and addresses image compression and super-resolution. We adapt a representative set of LRs, spanning Implicit, Hybrid, and Explicit methods, so as to operate reliably at the gigapixel scale on consumer hardware. Through systematic evaluation across reconstruction quality, model size, compression and inference times, we identify consistent trends across methods and suggest actionable guidance for future investigation.
blocks.zh: 可学习的表示力(LRs)可以将函数的参数化家族配合到各种信号中. 这些新兴神经-内生数据格式因其紧凑性,分辨率-不可知性以及可直接进行神经处理的通融性,正在引起科学界的兴趣. 另一方面,千兆像素的图像正在日益普及到各种科学、文化和工业领域。 在本文中,我们介绍了Giga Bench,这是第一个基准和实验评价,重点是部署带有千兆像素图像的LRs. Giga Bench包括不同领域收集、获取和合成的图像,并处理图像压缩和超分辨率问题。 我们调整了一套具有代表性的LR, 包括隐形、混合和显性的方法, 以便以千兆像素规模可靠地运行在消费硬件上。 通过对重建质量、模型规模、压缩和推断时间的系统评价,我们查明了不同方法的一致趋势,并为今后的调查提出了可采取行动的指导。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The emergence of Learnable Representations (LRs) has opened up a different paradigm for image storage, reconstruction and processing.
Rather than representing an image as a discrete grid of pixel values, LRs enable encoding it as a continuous function, defined by a set of optimizable parameters, that maps spatial coordinates to color values.
Prominent variants of LRs include Implicit Representations [ 45 , 30 , 12 ] , which encode an image in the weights of an MLP; Hybrid Representations [ 36 , 48 , 10 ] , which additionally incorporate spatially localized learnable features; and Explicit Representations [ 55 , 28 ] , which represent images using Gaussian primitives.
LRs have attracted significant attention for their compactness, resolution-agnosticism and amenability to direct neural processing.
As a matter of fact, several recent works [ 15 , 52 , 20 , 3 ] have shown how the learned parameters can be fed into specifically designed meta-networks to perform downstream tasks like classification and retrieval, without requiring reconstruction of the original discrete signal.
Such property positions LRs as a pathway to a new generation of neural-native data formats.
blocks.zh:
学习性代表(LRs)的出现开启了图像存储,重建和处理的不同范式.
LRs不代表图像作为像素值的离散网格,而是允许将其编码为连续函数,由一组可选择参数定义,将空间坐标映射到颜色值.
LR的显著变体包括隐性表示 [45, 30, 12], 将图像编码为 MLP 的权重; 混合表示 [36, 48, 10], 附加了空间本地化的可学习特征; 明性表示 [55, 28], 代表图像使用高斯原始.
LRs因其紧凑性,分辨率-不可知性,以及直接进行神经处理的通融性而引起极大关注.
事实上,最近几部作品[15,52,20,3]已经展示了如何将学到的参数输入专门设计的元网络,以完成分类和检索等下游任务,而不需要重建原来的离散信号.
此类财产职位 LRs作为新一代神经内生数据格式的路径.

blocks.en:
On the other hand, digital imaging is undergoing a quiet resolution revolution, as gigapixel images are becoming increasingly common across a variety of scientific, cultural, and industrial domains, from whole-slide pathology imaging [ 7 , 14 ] and satellite remote sensing [ 11 ] to high-fidelity museum digitisation and panoramic photography [ 24 ] .
Yet, the paradigms and tools for handling images at this scale remain largely anchored to classical pipelines, designed in an era when such resolutions were inconceivable.
Hence, we pose a timely research question concerning whether and how LRs can be effectively deployed for gigapixel-scale images, and which of their variants show the greatest promise for enabling adoption within this increasingly relevant regime.
However, despite the favourable properties of LRs and the increasing adoption of gigapixel imagery, the current literature lacks a comprehensive and rigorous evaluation of LR methods on gigapixel images.
Indeed, the reported experimental findings primarily concern datasets with much lower and more conventional resolutions, typically ranging from less than one megapixel to a few megapixels, where the computational cost of fitting LRs remains easily tractable.
The gigapixel regime, however, introduces fundamentally different challenges, as fitting a single image may require hours of training, naive partitioning strategies introduce boundary artifacts, and memory constraints force architectural compromises that do not arise at standard resolutions.
Adapting existing LRs to this setting is therefore a non-trivial task.
blocks.zh:
另一方面,数字成像正在经历一场静静的解析革命,因为千兆像图象在各种科学、文化和工业领域越来越普遍,从全滑坡病理学成像[7、14]和卫星遥感[11]到高真度博物馆数字化和全景摄影[24]。
然而,处理这种规模的图像的范式和工具在很大程度上仍然以古典管道为主,而设计这种管道的时代是无法想象的。
因此,我们提出一个及时的研究问题,即LRs是否能够以及如何有效地用于千兆像素图像,以及其中哪一种变体最有希望在这个日益相关的制度内促进收养。
然而,尽管LRs具有有利的属性,而且Gigapixel图像日益被采用,但目前的文献缺乏对Gigapixel图像上的LR方法的全面和严格的评价.
事实上,所报告的实验结果主要涉及分辨率低得多、更常规的数据集,通常从不到一个兆像素到几兆像素不等,在这些数据集,安装LRs的计算成本仍然很容易拉动。
然而,千兆像素制度带来了根本不同的挑战,因为配上单一的图像可能需要数小时的训练,天真的分割策略引入了边界文物,记忆限制迫使标准决议没有出现的建筑妥协。
适应现有 因此,进入这一环境的LR是非三角任务。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce GigaBench , a benchmark specifically designed to address the aforementioned scientific questions and foster research into the design of LR approaches suitable for gigapixel imagery.
We curate a collection of gigapixel images across diverse domains and evaluate LRs on compression and super-resolution under controlled settings.
Our evaluation spans the three main families of approaches: Implicit, Hybrid and Explicit Gaussian-based Representations.
Our analysis reveals several consistent trends across the three families.
Hybrid representations achieve the highest reconstruction fidelity but are structurally limited to moderate compression ratios, as their grid-based components impose a memory floor that prevents compression at extreme rates.
On the other hand, they neatly outperform other LR approaches when it comes to super-resolution, although a human evaluation suggests that the merits of LR at the gigapixel scales are somewhat uncertain compared to classical methodologies, such as bicubic interpolation.
Implicit representations, by contrast, can provide high to extreme compression ratios, trading fidelity for compression.
Explicit representations exhibit the most variable intra-family behaviours in both compression and super-resolution, with performance depending heavily on the chosen parametrisation.
Across all families, no single approach dominates uniformly as the optimal choice depends on the target compression or super-resolution ratio, as well as on the quality-speed trade-off.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了Giga Bench,这是一个专门用来解决上述科学问题和促进研究适合千兆像素图像的LR方法设计的基准。
我们整理了各种域的千兆像素图像,并评价在受控环境下的压缩和超分辨率。
我们的评估涉及三个主要方面:隐性、混合和明确的高斯代表。
我们的分析表明,这三个家庭出现了若干一致的趋势。
混合表示实现最高的重建忠贞度,但结构上仅限于中度压缩比,因为其网格组件强制规定一个内存底部,防止在极端速率下压缩.
另一方面,在超分辨率方面,它们巧妙地超越了其他LR方法,尽管人类评价认为,与古典方法相比,LR在千兆尺度上的优点是有些不确定的,比如双立插值.
相比之下,隐含的表示可以提供高至极的压缩比,交易忠诚度进行压缩.
明确表述在压缩和超解方面显示的家庭内部行为最可变,其表现在很大程度上取决于所选择的瘫痪状态。
在所有家庭,没有一个单一的方法统一支配,因为最佳选择取决于目标压缩或超分辨率比率,以及质量-速度权衡。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarised as follows: (i) we introduce a curated benchmark of gigapixel images spanning 10 scenes and different domains, released publicly to foster future research; (ii) we provide a systematic comparison of representative Implicit, Hybrid, and Explicit representations to gigapixel image compression and super-resolution; (iii) we characterise the practical trade-offs among the specific methods evaluated across fidelity, speed, and downstream usability, offering concrete guidance for researchers and practitioners working in this emerging regime.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下:(一) 我们采用覆盖10个场景和不同领域的千兆像素图像的全方位基准,公开发布以促进未来的研究;(二) 我们系统地比较了代表千兆像素图像压缩和超解的隐含、混合和明确表述;(三) 我们将实际权衡的特征确定为评估的跨忠诚、速度和下游可用性的具体方法,为在这一新兴制度中工作的研究人员和从业人员提供具体指导。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Learnable Representations are a continuous signal representation paradigm in which a function parametrized by a set of weights is optimized to map coordinates to the values of a target signal.
This abstraction is broad enough to cover image [ 9 ] , video [ 8 ] , and audio reconstruction [ 45 ] , neural radiance fields [ 35 ] , SDF fitting [ 38 ] , inverse problem solving, and more.
In this work, we focus on images.
Their main advantages include resolution agnosticism, a parameter count decoupled from sampling density, and full differentiability of the input domain.
We divide LRs into three main categories, described in the following sections: Implicit Representations (IRs), Hybrid Representations (HRs), and Explicit Representations (ERs).
blocks.zh:
可学习的表示是一个连续的信号表示范式,在这个范式中,通过一组权重对一个函数进行优化,将坐标映射到目标信号的值.
这个抽象内容足够宽广,可以覆盖图像[9],视频[8],以及音频重建[45],神经辐射场[35],SDF配 [38],反向问题解决,等等.
在这个作品中,我们专注于图像.
它们的主要优点包括分辨率不可知论,一个参数计数与采样密度脱钩,以及输入域完全不同.
我们把LR分为三大类,在以下各节中加以说明:隐性代表、混合代表以及明确代表。

blocks.en:
Implicit representations [ 51 ] parametrize the function as a Multi-Layer Perceptron.
Their principal drawback is the spectral bias of MLP-based approximators, which favors low frequencies and impedes fitting fine-grained signal content [ 40 ] .
Following the taxonomy of [ 17 ] , IRs differ along two axes: coordinate encoding and activation design, and network architecture.
On the first, random Fourier feature mappings lift input coordinates into a high-dimensional sinusoidal basis before a standard MLP [ 46 ] , while a complementary line replaces ReLU with intrinsically high-frequency activations: periodic sinusoids [ 45 ] , complex Gabor wavelets [ 43 ] , Gaussians [ 41 ] , variable-period sinusoids [ 30 ] , and oscillator-based designs [ 12 ] .
More recent methods select activations adaptively from a learned dictionary [ 23 ] .
On the second, the inductive bias is moved into the architecture: multiplicative filter networks [ 18 ] replace additive layer composition with element-wise products of Fourier and Gabor filters, BACON [ 29 ] adds explicit per-layer bandwidth limits for multi-scale representation, and INCODE [ 25 ] couples the MLP with a conditioning sub-network that adapts activation parameters to the input.
Beyond signal fitting, IRs are increasingly used as a data representation in their own right, with the network weights as the object of downstream learning.
Functa [ 15 ] treats each datum as a function, learning a shared prior via per-sample modulations of a meta-learned backbone for classification and generation in function space. [ 13 ] and [ 52 ] instead embed the weights of independently fitted IRs into a compact latent space, enabling retrieval, segmentation, and generation without reconstructing the signal.
Recently, [ 20 ] fits IRs end-to-end with direct classifier feedback, addressing the structural inconsistency of weights optimized without downstream supervision.
blocks.zh:
隐含的表示 [51] 使功能瘫痪为多激光感知器.
他们的主要缺点是基于MLP的近似器的光谱偏差,它偏向于低频率,并阻碍适配的细纹信号内容[40].
在[17]的分类法之后,IRs沿两个轴线不同:坐标编码和激活设计,以及网络架构.
首先,随机Fourier特性映射在标准 MLP [46] 之前将升降输入坐标转化为高维度的sinusoid 基础,而互补线则以内在的高频激活取代ReLU:周期性sinusoids [45], 复杂 Gabor wavelets [43], Gaussians [41],可变时期的sinusoids [30],以及基于振荡器的设计 [12].
较近的方法从学习的词典中以适应性的方式选择激活[23].
第二,诱导偏差被移入架构中:多功能滤波器网络[18]用Fourier和Gabor滤波器的元素导向产品取代添加层组成,BACON[29]为多尺度的表示增加了明确的每层带宽限制,INCODE[25]与MLP对齐,并配有适应输入的激活参数的调节子网络.
除了信号装配, IRs本身越来越多地被用作数据代表,网络权重是下游学习的对象.
Functa [15] 将每个基准视为一个函数,通过每个样本在函数空间中进行分类和生成时先学习一个共享的元学习主干。 [13] 和 [52] 将独立安装的IRs的权重嵌入一个紧凑的潜伏空间,从而能够进行检索、分区和生成,而不重建信号。
最近,[20] 将IRs端到端与直接的分类器反馈相匹配,解决在没有下游监管的情况下优化加权的结构不一致问题.

blocks.en:
As the target signal grows in size and bandwidth, the spectral bias of pure IRs becomes increasingly difficult to overcome through activation and encoding design alone.
This motivates hybrid representations, which pair a lightweight MLP decoder with a learnable explicit structure, such as grids, hash tables, or basis functions, that injects spatial diversity and localizes capacity where the signal demands it.
ACORN [ 34 ] adaptively partitions the input domain into blocks, each assigned a small MLP, refining the partition to match local signal complexity.
MINER [ 44 ] represents the signal through a Laplacian pyramid of per-block coordinate networks, yielding a coarse-to-fine multi-scale decomposition.
Instant-NGP [ 36 ] couples a compact MLP with a multi-resolution hash grid of trainable feature vectors, achieving orders-of-magnitude speed-ups at the cost of hash collisions.
NeuRBF [ 10 ] generalizes the regular-grid prior to adaptive radial basis functions whose centers and shapes follow the signal, further composed with multi-frequency sinusoids to recover fine details.
MetricGrids [ 48 ] extends the grid paradigm with elementary grids defined in distinct metric spaces, acting as higher-order Taylor terms that approximate strongly non-linear signals more faithfully than linear interpolation alone.
blocks.zh:
随着目标信号的大小和带宽的增加,单纯的IRs的光谱偏差越来越难以单独通过激活和编码设计来克服.
这激发了混合表示,将一个轻量级的MLP解码器与可以学习的显性结构,如网格,散列表,或基础函数相配合,注入空间多样性,并在信号需要的地方将能力本地化.
ACORN [34] 适应性地将输入域分割成块,每个块分配一个小的MLP,精制分区以匹配局部信号复杂度.
MINER [44]通过每块坐标网的拉普拉西安金字塔代表信号,产生粗对细的多尺度分解.
即时-NGP [36] 配对一个具有多分辨率散列可训练特性矢量网的紧凑型MLP,以散列碰撞为代价实现放大速度的订单.
NeuRBF[10]在适应性射线基础功能之前将正网进行概括,其中心与形状都跟随信号,进一步由多频率的sinusoid组成以恢复细细的细节.
MetricGrids [48] 扩展了网格范式,将基本网格定义为不同的公尺空格,作为泰勒语的更高顺序术语,其近似非线性信号比单线性插值更忠实.

blocks.en:
Explicit representations parametrize a signal as a collection of graphic primitives placed directly in the signal domain, with their location and shape exposed as optimization variables.
They have been investigated under a variety of primitives, including Gabor wavelets [ 50 ] , triangles [ 21 , 22 ] , and anisotropic Gaussians [ 26 ] .
Among these, Gaussians adapt most naturally to image fitting: GaussianImage [ 55 ] reduces 3D Gaussian Splattings [ 26 ] to eight parameters per primitive and a tile-based rasterizer operating at 10 3 10^{3} FPS.
Subsequent work scales the paradigm to ultra-high-resolution inputs via feature-aware sampling [ 28 ] and multi-scale seeded parametrizations [ 37 ] , with further variants refining initialization and density control [ 53 ] .
blocks.zh:
明确表示将一个信号作为直接放置在信号域的图形原始物的集合,将其位置和形状暴露为优化变量.
被调查的有各种原始人,包括加博尔波列特[50],三角[21,22],以及异构高斯人[26].
其中, 高斯人最自然地适应图像配对: 高斯图像 [55] 减少 3D Gaussian Splatetings [26] to 8 参数每原始和一台以瓷砖为基础的光栅,运行于10 3 10^{3} FPS.
随后的工作通过特征感知采样[28]和多尺度播种伞化[37],将范式对超高分辨率输入进行尺度化,进一步变种精细化初始化和密度控制[53].

blocks.en:
Despite the breadth and maturity of these methods, existing evaluations most commonly rely on Kodak [ 27 ] and DIV2K [ 1 ] , datasets originally designed for classical compression benchmarking rather than for assessing neural representations.
Yet even these are not used consistently, as different works evaluate on different subsets, at different resolutions, under different compression ratio definitions, and with different metrics, making cross-paper comparisons unreliable even when the data is the same.
No prior work has systematically evaluated these methods at a gigapixel scale, a regime that introduces qualitatively distinct challenges in fitting cost, memory, and rate-distortion behaviour. GigaBench addresses that gap.
blocks.zh:
尽管有这些方法的广度和成熟度,但现有的评价通常依赖于Kodak[27]和DIV2K[1],数据集最初是为古典压缩基准设计的,而不是用于评估神经表达.
然而,即使是这些也并非一致使用,因为不同的作品对不同的子集,不同的分辨率,不同的压缩比率定义,以及不同的度量衡进行评价,即使数据相同,反纸比较也变得不可靠.
以往的工作没有系统地评估这些方法的千兆像素规模,这种制度在适应成本、内存和扭曲率行为方面提出了质地不同的挑战。 Giga Bench解决了这个缺口。

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en:
GigaBench comprises 10 10 images, curated from publicly available sources according to four design principles: • Gigapixel Resolution. Each image meets or marginally exceeds the one-gigapixel threshold (in practice, 1.0 1.0 – 1.19 1.19 GPx).
We enforce this floor so the benchmark deliberately clears the symbolic gigapixel mark, and caps it both for uniformity across the set and to keep fitting feasible on consumer hardware; • Domain Diversity. The images span panoramas, industrial scans, scientific histopathology slides, satellite imagery at varying scales, and synthetic images.
This range addresses several domains where gigapixel images are becoming increasingly relevant; • Lossless Appearance. Many gigapixel images distributed online are stored as JPEG files and thus carry compression artifacts.
We exclude these images: since each representation method introduces artifacts of its own, pre-existing ones would add up and be difficult to disentangle from reconstruction errors; • Licensing. We retain only images whose original license permits research use and redistribution. The dataset is released as a bundle under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 license, with attribution to this work, plus the individual attributions to the original authors of the images. Fig. 1 depicts the images comprising our benchmark, while Tab. 1 reports their metadata, with more details provided in the Supplementary.

Giga Bench由10幅图像组成,按照四个设计原则从公开来源整理: • Gigapixel分辨率. 每个图像都满足或略超过单吉加比素阈值(在实际操作中,1.0 1.0–1.19 1.19 GPx).
我们执行这个底线,因此基准故意清除象征性的千兆像素标记,并封顶它,既为了整个套装的统一性,也为了保持对消费硬件的适应性; • 领域多样性。 图像横跨全景、工业扫描、科学组织病理学幻灯片、不同尺度的卫星图像和合成图像。
这一范围涉及千兆像素图像日益相关的若干领域; • 无损失外观。 许多在线分布的千兆像素图像作为JPEG文件存储,从而携带压缩文物.
我们排除了这些图像:由于每一种表述方法都引入了它自己的文物,原有的文物将加起来,很难与重建错误分开; • 许可证。 我们只保留其原始许可证允许使用和重新分配的图像。 数据集根据Creative Communitys Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0许可证作为捆绑发布,归属于本作,加上个人归属于图像原作者. 图1描述了构成我们基准的图像,而图1则报告了它们的元数据,并在补编中提供了更多细节。

blocks.en: 3.2 Methods Selection
blocks.zh: 3.2 选择方法

blocks.en:
We evaluate compression and super-resolution performance across several LRs drawn from Implicit, Hybrid and Explicit Representations. As for super-resolution, we also compare LRs to classical interpolation methods, such as nearest-neighbour, bicubic, and Lanczos.
We select, within each family, at least one seminal method alongside one representing the current state of the art.
Moreover, the methods are used in different configurations, spanning three orders of magnitude of compression ratio ( 10 1 10^{1} , 10 2 10^{2} , 10 3 10^{3} ).
Within the family of Implicit Representations, we choose SIREN [ 45 ] as the seminal model, FINER [ 30 ] as a major advancement, especially in fitting sharper details, and FDHO [ 12 ] as a very recent improvement, yet it was tested at a very small scale for Image Compression.
All three models come in two architectures, as defined by the number of hidden layers and hidden features, and denoted by the pair (L, F): a ( 5,256 ) (5,256) architecture, as proposed in [ 45 ] , along with a ( 8 , 1024 ) (8,1024) variant, matching respectively the ∼ 100 \sim 100 and ∼ 1000 \sim 1000 scales (skipping ∼ 10 \sim 10 as it would have been computationally unfeasible).
As for Hybrid Representations, we consider the seminal Instant-NGP [ 36 ] , and the two main follow-ups NeuRBF [ 10 ] and MetricGrids [ 48 ] , each at two hash-table sizes, 2 24 2^{24} and 2 22 2^{22} , denoted as ( T = 24 T=24 ) and ( T = 22 T=22 ), respectively.
The first is the value recommended by [ 36 , 48 ] for gigapixel fitting, while the second is recommended to fit images in general.
These configurations address the ∼ 10 \sim 10 scale, landing at ∼ 5 \sim 5 and ∼ 15 \sim 15 respectively.
Concerning Explicit Representations, we choose the seminal GaussianImage [ 55 ] method and the more recent SmartSplat [ 28 ] , as it has been trained and evaluated at the highest resolution (DIV16K dataset), while also being robust enough to converge at very high compression ratios.
Given the possibility to choose the number of Gaussians, we could select configurations that match 15,100 15,100 , and 3000 3000 compression ratios.
However, as the forward step of Gaussian splatting scales linearly with the number of pixels, it is unfeasible to compute it for gigapixel images on a consumer GPU.
For this reason, we split the image into tiles and leverage gradient accumulation to reduce the memory footprint while maintaining the same theoretical accuracy.
Additional details in Sec. I and Algorithm 1 of the Supplementary.

blocks.en: 3.3 Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 计量

blocks.en:
We evaluate reconstruction quality via Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM, reported in the Supplementary) [ 49 ] , which together capture both pixel-level fidelity and perceptual structure preservation.
Compression efficiency is measured by the Compression Ratio (CR), defined as the ratio between the size in bytes of the uncompressed image and that of the stored Learned Representation: CR = H ⋅ W ⋅ 3 ⋅ sizeof ​ ( uint8 ) # ​ Params ⋅ sizeof ​ ( float32 ) \text{CR}=\frac{H\cdot W\cdot 3\cdot\text{sizeof}(\text{uint8})}{\#\text{Params}\cdot\text{sizeof}(\text{float32})} (1) To characterize computational cost, we report Compression Time (CT), the time required to fit the representation to the given image, and Inference Time (IT), the time required to decode the full image from the fitted representation.
CT is particularly critical in the gigapixel regime, where it reaches several hours, and IT affects the practical adoption of the representation whenever the image must be fully reconstructed for downstream use.
While PSNR and CR are intrinsic to the representation and thus directly comparable across methods regardless of codebase, CT and IT are runtime measurements of each method’s reference implementation.

blocks.en:
In the LRs setting, Super-Resolution consists of querying the fitted model on a coordinate grid finer than the one used during training, with the expectation that the reconstructed image preserves edges and fine-grained patterns more faithfully than classical interpolation methods.
To address this standard setting, we downsample the GigaBench images by × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 , then fit LRs on the downsampled versions and assess the reconstruction quality of images sampled on a finer grid relative to the corresponding original.
Yet, it has been observed that the popular distortion metrics used to evaluate reconstruction methods, like PSNR and SSIM, may correlate poorly with human perceptual judgement [ 5 ] . This is particularly the case in super-resolution, where perceptually relevant cues relate to sharpness, texture fidelity, and artifact structure rather than pixel-level distortion.
Therefore, to complement our experimental assessment of LRs for super-resolution, we designed and carried out a human evaluation study.
Participants were recruited through an open call, with the study link publicly released and further spread by word of mouth. Each was shown the outputs of four methods: the best-performing model from each of the Implicit, Hybrid, and Explicit LR families, plus the best classical algorithm, and asked to rank them by perceived quality, i.e., sharpness of detail, absence of artifacts, and overall visual fidelity.
Stimuli were 2048 2 2048^{2} crops, manually selected to be visually engaging and to span a diverse spectrum of low- and high-frequency content.
All participants saw the full set, with crop order and method arrangement randomized per participant to avoid ordering and position biases, and could freely zoom to inspect fine texture and artifacts.
From the collected rankings, we derive an Elo score via the Plackett–Luce model [ 39 , 31 ] , following the protocol of established human preference benchmarks for image generation such as Arena AI [ 2 ] , mapping the estimated strengths θ i \theta_{i} onto the Elo scale as E i = k ⋅ θ i + A E_{i}=k\cdot\theta_{i}+A , with anchor A A fixed to 1000 and scaling factor k = 400 / ln ⁡ ( 10 ) k=400/\ln(10) .

为解决这个标准设定,我们将 Giga Bench 图像通过 × 4\time 4 和 × 8\time 8 进行下采样,然后在下采样版本上与 LRs 相匹配,并比对相应的原版对更细网格上采样的图像的重建质量进行评估.

因此,为了补充我们对LRs超分辨率的实验性评估,我们设计和开展了一项人类评价研究。
通过公开呼吁招聘了学员,公开发布了学习链接,并通过口语进一步传播。 每种方法都显示了四种方法的输出:来自隐形、混合和显性LR家族的性能最好的模型,加上最好的古典算法,并要求按照所感知的质量,即细节的尖锐性、缺乏文物以及整体的视觉忠贞度来排序。

blocks.en:
Tab. 2 reports PSNR (dB), Compression Time (CT, minutes), Inference Time (IT, seconds) and Compression Ratio (CR) for all images in GigaBench and for all considered methods.
Hybrid representations achieve the highest reconstruction fidelity across the board, with MetricGrids ( T = 24 \text{T}=24 ) and I-NGP ( T = 24 \text{T}=24 ) reaching 33.59 33.59 dB and 33.19 33.19 dB, respectively, but are structurally confined to lower compression ratios ( CR ≈ 5 \text{CR}\approx 5 – 16 × 16\times ), as their hash-table capacity sets a hard floor on model size.
Within this family and configuration, I-NGP stands out for its fitting efficiency, completing in under 2 2 minutes on average, while MetricGrids requires up to almost 19 19 minutes for a marginal quality gain, suggesting I-NGP offers a more practical operating point for most use cases.
Such an advantage is not only due to the lighter decoding of I-NGP, but especially to the original implementation, as NVIDIA’s I-NGP code relies on custom CUDA kernels while MetricGrids is fully developed using PyTorch.
Both configurations of NeuRBF lag behind by approximately 2 2 dB, indicating that adaptive radial basis functions transfer less effectively to the gigapixel setting.
Implicit representations occupy the opposite end of the compression spectrum.
The smaller variants operate at CR ≈ 2600 × \text{CR}~\approx~2600\times , achieving 18 18 – 20 20 dB PSNR at compression times close to the slowest hybrid methods ( ∼ \sim 18 18 – 25 25 minutes).
The bigger variants trade compression ratio for quality ( CR ≈ 102 × \text{CR}~\approx~102\times , ∼ \sim 22 22 – 23 ​ dB 23~\text{dB} ) at the cost of dramatically longer compression times, up to 206 minutes.
Quality differences across activation functions (SIREN, FINER, FDHO) are modest within each architecture, suggesting that at the gigapixel scale, the bottleneck lies in the fitting budget rather than the activation design.
Explicit Representations exhibit the largest intra-family variance.
SmartSplat maintains competitive quality across all tested compression ratios, reaching 30.40 30.40 dB at CR = 15 \text{CR}=15 and degrading gracefully to 24.05 24.05 dB at CR = 3000 \text{CR}=3000 .
GaussianImage, by contrast, collapses at high compression: while it reaches 17.73 17.73 dB at CR = 15 \text{CR}=15 , its PSNR drops catastrophically to 5.58 5.58 dB at CR = 3000 \text{CR}=3000 , well below acceptable perceptual quality.
This gap underscores that the choice of Gaussian parametrisation is critical at extreme compression ratios, and that results obtained with one Gaussian-based method should not be generalised to the family as a whole.
Yet, both Explicit methods offer the fastest inference times among the considered LRs.
Finally, in Fig. 3 we report the quality (PSNR) vs. Compression Ratio (CR) plot. We note that implicit methods can achieve extreme compression consistently exceeding 1000 × 1000\times , albeit with the lowest overall PSNR. Conversely, Hybrid methods deliver the highest reconstruction quality but are largely constrained to the low-compression regime ( 10 × 10\times – 30 × 30\times ). Explicit representations bridge this gap, spanning the widest range of CRs. Notably, SmartSplat at CR = 3000 \text{CR}=3000 maintains a clear PSNR advantage over Implicit methods at similar extreme CRs.

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 illustrates the Quality vs. Efficiency landscape, plotting the PSNR along with the Compression Time (CT) and Inference Time (IT).
The CT plot reveals a separation between families.
I-NGP is the outlier in the Hybrid group, fitting an image in under 1.7 1.7 minutes on average at any tested ratio, an order of magnitude faster than MetricGrids and several times faster than NeuRBF, at equivalent CR, and faster than any other LRs overall.
Explicit representations are more expensive to train, with SmartSplat consistently exceeding GaussianImage and both exhibiting a counter-intuitive inverse scaling.
Indeed, fitting an image at CR = 15 \text{CR}=15 costs substantially more than at CR = 3000 \text{CR}=3000 , as allocating more primitives demands longer optimisation.
The larger (8,1024) Implicit architectures are the slowest overall, approaching 175 175 – 206 206 minutes per image, with a modest quality advantage over the smaller (5,256) variants.
Such separation is also observable in the IT plot.
Explicit representations, despite their high CT, are the quickest to decode, with SmartSplat decoding in 0.62, 1.31, and 3.36 seconds for CR 3000, 100, and 15, respectively, making them the only family compatible with latency-sensitive downstream pipelines.
The larger implicit variants also pay the steepest inference penalty, approaching 7 7 – 11 11 minutes to decode a single gigapixel image, which largely precludes their use in interactive applications.
Hybrid methods occupy a stable middle ground, decoding in 10 10 – 40 40 seconds regardless of their hash-table size, offering a predictable and practical operating point.
These considerations highlight that practitioners face a multidimensional trade-off when choosing an LR to handle gigapixel images.
Training and inference costs are largely inversely correlated across families, as the methods that yield the fastest decoding times are the slowest at compression time, and vice versa, while compression ratio is heavily constrained by the chosen representation’s capacity.

blocks.en:
Tab. 3 reports PSNR at × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 upsampling factors for all images in GigaBench .
The super-resolution performance unveils a different picture from the compression task, highlighting several findings.
The most salient observation is that classical methods are highly competitive in the gigapixel regime.
For example, bicubic interpolation outperforms all Implicit Representations at both upsampling scales.
Indeed, the (8, 1024) variants approach bicubic performance at × 4 \times 4 ( 22.31 22.31 – 22.89 22.89 dB), and the (5, 256) variants fall 3 3 – 5 5 dB below.
However, Hybrid Representations are the only family to consistently surpass classical baselines.
I-NGP ( T = 24 \text{T}=24 ) leads at × 4 \times 4 with 27.11 27.11 dB ( + 1.11 +1.11 dB over bicubic interpolation), while MetricGrids ( T = 24 \text{T}=24 ) achieves 26.86 26.86 dB.
Notably, the advantage over classical methods narrows at × 8 \times 8 , where I-NGP ( T = 24 \text{T}=24 ) leads by only 0.68 0.68 dB, suggesting that the representational advantage of grid-based hybrids diminishes as the upsampling demand increases.
NeuRBF again falls behind both I-NGP and MetricGrids by approximately ∼ 2 \sim 2 dB at × 4 \times 4 , narrowing to less than 1 1 dB at × 8 \times 8 .
Explicit Representations exhibit once again the most variable behaviour.
SmartSplat ( CR = 3000 \text{CR}=3000 ) achieves 24.04 24.04 dB at × 4 \times 4 and degrades gracefully to 22.83 22.83 dB at × 8 \times 8 , remaining competitive with classical methods.
GaussianImage, however, displays severe instability.
While GaussianImage ( CR = 100 \text{CR}=100 ) reaches 21.93 21.93 dB at × 4 \times 4 , GaussianImage ( CR = 15 \text{CR}=15 ) collapses at × 8 \times 8 ( 9.23 9.23 dB), suggesting that the low-CR regime over-allocates Gaussian primitives to low-frequency content at the expense of generalisation to unseen scales.
At gigapixel resolution, the expectation that LRs confer an advantage in super-resolution does not hold uniformly, and practitioners should not discount classical baselines.

blocks.en:
As PSNR is a known imperfect proxy for perceptual quality [ 5 ] , we complement the quantitative results obtained in the super-resolution experiments with a human evaluation study, conducted with 170 participants.
We excluded Andromeda from the study after observing that its crops did not provide sufficient context for participants to reliably assess the quality of the upsampled image.
For each family, we selected as representative the method yielding the highest average PSNR, with the exception of Hybrid Representations, where we selected MetricGrids (T=24) for both the × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 settings.
Although I-NGP attains a marginally higher PSNR at × 4 \times 4 , we observed that its super-resolved outputs are qualitatively poor, as high-resolution queries within the same low-resolution cell collapse to near-identical values, producing blocky, piecewise-constant reconstructions that lack genuine high-frequency detail.
MetricGrids, by contrast, recovers more faithful structure.
Additional analysis can be found in Sec. F of the Supplementary. Fig. 4 reports the Elo scores, bootstrapped 2000 times, at × 4 \times 4 (Top) and × 8 \times 8 (Bottom).
The results corroborate the quantitative findings of Tab. 3 , but highlight nuances that PSNR alone does not capture.
At × 4 \times 4 , Classic interpolations are preferred overall, followed closely by Hybrid Representations, with Implicit and Explicit methods ranking substantially lower.
Among the two, the Implicit family is clearly preferred over the Explicit one.
The tight bootstrap confidence intervals confirm that this ranking is statistically meaningful.
At × 8 \times 8 , Hybrid representations close the gap to classical algorithms, reaching essentially equivalent perceptual quality at the top of the overall ranking.
At the bottom of the ranking, Explicit methods gain ground on Implicit ones.
However, both remain far below the Hybrid and Classical methods.
While the reconstructions provided by Implicit and Explicit methods may be competitive in terms of PSNR, they are perceptually penalised for smooth outputs that suppress fine textures rather than plausibly hallucinate them.
The per-image breakdown shows that the family-level ranking is broadly consistent across domains, with Hybrid and Classical methods leading in nearly every scene, indicating that the findings are not driven by any single image type.
The one notable outlier is Venice at × 4 \times 4 , where Classic methods dominate by an unusually large margin, likely reflecting the sensitivity of fine architectural detail in the panoramic image to the smoothing artifacts provided by LRs at moderate upsampling factors.

blocks.en: 4.3 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 定性分析

blocks.en:
In Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 , we show qualitative results for the Compression and Super-Resolution tasks.
These figures highlight characteristic failure modes for each family.
Implicit representations produce blurry reconstructions, a direct consequence of the spectral bias of MLP-based approximators [ 46 ] .
This is most severe in texture-rich domains.
Indeed, in the Breast Cancer histopathology crops, fine tissue structures are smoothed into an unintelligible wash at both upsampling factors, rendering Implicit methods unsuitable for scientific imaging applications where fine-grained detail is diagnostically relevant.
Explicit Gaussian-based representations, while achieving good results in the compression task, exhibit the most visually striking failure modes in super-resolution.
At × 8 \times 8 , ringing and ghosting artifacts are clearly visible around high-contrast edges, as seen in the Venice pillar crop, and individual Gaussian primitives become perceptually distinct in the Breast Cancer crop, producing a characteristic blob-like texture that bears no structural resemblance to the underlying tissue.
Hybrid representations are the most perceptually robust family overall, providing reconstructions that remain close to the ground truth across all tested images and in both compression and super-resolution experiments.
Classical methods, while producing no artifacts, introduce the characteristic smoothing of interpolation-based methods, more clearly visible as a slight loss of sharpness in fine structural detail at × 8 \times 8 relative to the ground-truth.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
We introduced GigaBench , a curated benchmark of gigapixel images spanning ten scenes across diverse domains, and used it to systematically compare Learnable Representations on both Compression and Super-Resolution.
This lets us revisit the two questions that motivated our study: whether and how LRs can be effectively deployed at gigapixel scale, and which family is most promising.
On the first, LRs can indeed be brought to the gigapixel regime, but only with dedicated adaptation, such as tiling and gradient accumulation, and at a computational cost that becomes a decisive selection criterion rather than a secondary concern.
On the second, no single family dominates, and the right choice depends on the task, the target compression ratio, and the application constraints.
For Compression, Hybrid Representations are the clear recommendation at moderate ratios, with I-NGP offering a particularly favourable quality vs. compression time trade-off thanks to its CUDA-optimized implementation.
When extreme compression is required, Implicit representations and SmartSplat are viable options.
The latter remains competitive across the full compression spectrum and yields the fastest inference among the implementations we benchmarked, making it the natural choice for latency-sensitive downstream tasks, provided fitting cost is not a bottleneck.
For super-resolution, the results are more nuanced.
Classical methods retain a robust perceptual advantage at × 4 \times 4 , while at × 8 \times 8 Hybrid representations match them in human preference.
Finally, the divergence between PSNR and human-preference rankings highlights that quantitative metrics are necessary but not sufficient in perceptually demanding regimes.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Giga Bench, 一个覆盖不同领域十景的千兆像素图像的全景基准,

首先,LR确实可以被带入千兆像素制度,但只能通过专门的适应,如板块和梯度积聚,并且以计算成本成为决定性的选择标准而不是次要关注.

blocks.en:
GigaBench provides the infrastructure to conduct both forms of evaluation at gigapixel scale, and we encourage future work to treat human assessment as a primary rather than supplementary signal.
Although our findings reveal properties of the considered LR families in the giga-pixel regime, they stem from a ten-scene benchmark and thus should not be interpreted as broad, general conclusions.

虽然我们的调查结果揭示了在千兆像素制度下被考虑的LR家族的属性,但它们来源于十景基准,因此不应被解释为广义的一般结论。

blocks.en: A Limitations and Intended Scope
blocks.zh: 限制和范围

blocks.en:
GigaBench comprises ten scenes, one or two per domain, and evaluates eight methods in sixteen configurations.
Every result in this paper should be read under that scope.
Our claims are comparative statements about the specific methods and configurations we evaluate, measured on these ten images, and they characterise the trade-offs a practitioner faces when choosing among them at gigapixel resolution.
They are not estimates of the expected behaviour of a representation family over the population of gigapixel images, and the averages we report are correspondingly sensitive to individual scenes: with one or two images per domain, a single scene can move a family average by more than the margins that separate families.
The benchmark therefore does not support domain-level conclusions, and we draw none.
Nor does it support claims that a family is intrinsically better or worse than another, as opposed to the evaluated instances of that family, since intra-family variance is in several cases larger than the inter-family gap.
Whether the trends we observe persist over a broader distribution of gigapixel imagery is an open question. Within this scope, however, we intend the benchmark to serve as an empirical guide and a starting point for practitioners choosing a representation for their own gigapixel workloads, to be refined as the evidence base grows.

The domain labels described in Tab. 1 alone are insufficient to attest to the GigaBench ’s diversity.
Thus, we complement this work with a set of low-level complexity statistics for every image.
We consider four complementary families:

blocks.en:
• Spectral statistics. Natural images exhibit power-law spectra P ⁡ ( f ) ∝ 1 / f β P(f)\!\propto\!1/f^{\beta} with β ≈ 2 \beta\!\approx\!2 [ 19 , 42 ] .
The slope β \beta measures how quickly energy decays with spatial frequency: a low β \beta means the image keeps substantial energy at fine scales (rich detail), a high β \beta means it is dominated by smooth, large-scale structure.
We fit β \mathbf{\beta} by least squares on the log–log radially averaged power spectral density (PSD) of the Hann-windowed, mean-removed full image, over log-spaced frequency bins in [ 0.02 , 0.80 ] ​ f Ny [0.02,0.80]\,f_{\mathrm{Ny}} .
The fit 𝐑 𝟐 \mathbf{R^{2}} tells whether a power law is a good model in the first place.
Since a single slope cannot describe spectra that deviate from a power law, we also report 𝐄 HF \mathbf{E_{\mathrm{HF}}} , the fraction of (non-DC) spectral energy above 0.25 ​ f Ny 0.25\,f_{\mathrm{Ny}} . • Edge statistics. We report two measures of how many edges an image contains.
The mean Scharr gradient magnitude ∥ ∇ I ∥ ¯ \overline{\lVert\nabla I\rVert} needs no threshold and captures all local intensity variation, but it does not distinguish clean contours from noise.
The Canny edge-pixel density ρ edge \rho_{\mathrm{edge}} (thresholds 100 / 200 100/200 on 8-bit luma) does the opposite: it depends on the chosen thresholds, but its non-maximum suppression and hysteresis keep only salient, connected contours. • Entropy statistics. The Shannon entropy H H of the 256-bin luminance histogram gives the bits/pixel needed to encode each pixel on its own, ignoring where values occur.
We pair it with the bits/pixel of a fixed lossless codec (JPEG XL, effort 7) on the RGB image, which also exploits the similarity between nearby pixels and thus estimates the image’s entropy rate (codec-dependent, but comparable across images since the codec is fixed). • Texture statistics. From the symmetric grey-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM; 32 levels, distance 1, averaged over 4 orientations) we report contrast , ∑ i , j p ⁡ ( i , j ) ​ ( i − j ) 2 \sum_{i,j}p(i,j)(i-j)^{2} , and homogeneity , ∑ i , j p ⁡ ( i , j ) / ( 1 + ( i − j ) 2 ) \sum_{i,j}p(i,j)/(1+(i-j)^{2}) .

blocks.en:
, the SSIM evaluation broadly corroborates the PSNR-based conclusions of the main paper.
At the category level, the ordering is largely preserved, with a single exception.
Indeed, the Hybrid and Explicit groups swap, so that the ranking changes from Hybrid–Explicit–Implicit under PSNR, to Explicit–Hybrid–Implicit under SSIM, while the Implicit group retain its position.
Intra-category orderings are almost entirely preserved, with only two swaps, one within the Implicit and one within the Hybrid family, both confined to lower-ranked methods rather than the category leaders, and therefore of limited consequence.
The dataset-induced spread is likewise preserved: the high-frequency images that prove difficult under PSNR (e.g., Italy , Munich , Andromeda ) remain the hardest under SSIM across all categories, confirming that the proposed benchmark stresses image regression methods consistently across fidelity measures.
The category-level swap is attributable entirely to SmartSplat.
Under SSIM, SmartSplat (CR = 15 =15 ) attains the best compression score on 8 8 of the 10 10 images and the highest dataset average ( 0.886 0.886 ), a margin that is not present in the PSNR table, where the category sits 2 2 – 3 3 dB below the Hybrid frontier.
We attribute this to SmartSplat’s training objective, which combines an L 1 L_{1} term with an SSIM term and therefore directly optimizes the metric reported here.
This is consistent with the broader observation that PSNR and SSIM rankings can disagree when a competing method is trained against the metric in question, and motivates reporting both when benchmarking image regression methods on the proposed dataset.

blocks.en: E Quantitative Perceptual Similarity on Super Resolution
blocks.zh: E 超解析度的观念相似性

blocks.en:
As discussed in the main paper, PSNR and SSIM are distortion metrics that quantify agreement with a reference and are known to correlate poorly with perceived quality in Super-Resolution, which motivated our human evaluation.
To complement both perspectives with a quantitative perceptual measure, we additionally report LPIPS [ 54 ] , which computes a learned, human-calibrated distance between deep features of the reconstruction and the reference, and is the de facto standard perceptual metric in the super-resolution literature.
Evaluating LPIPS at gigapixel scale, however, is non-trivial: the memory footprint of a single forward pass grows linearly with the number of pixels, making full-image evaluation infeasible, and no established protocol exists in this regime.
We therefore adopt a tiled protocol: each reconstruction is partitioned into non-overlapping 8192 × 8192 8192\times 8192 tiles, and then averaged over them. Tab. 7 reports per-image LPIPS for every method at × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 upsampling, mirroring the layout of the PSNR and SSIM tables.
Despite not being mathematically equivalent to a single forward pass, this metric remains informative since LPIPS is inherently local: it spatially averages feature distances whose receptive field spans only a few hundred pixels, so the discrepancy is confined to tile boundaries, a negligible fraction of the area at this tile size.
blocks.zh:
正如在主要文件中所讨论的那样,PSNR和SSIM是扭曲的衡量标准,它们以参照方式对协议进行量化,而且众所周知,它们与《超级决议》中人们所认为的质量联系不大,这促使我们进行人类评价。
为了用定量的感知度量来补充这两个观点,我们又报告LPIPS[54],它计算了重建深层特征和参考物之间的一个经过人校准的学习的距离,是超分辨率文献中事实上的标准感知度量.
然而,在千兆像素尺度上评价LPIPS是非三进制的:单向前传的内存足迹随着像素数量而线性增长,使得全图像评价不可行,在这个制度下没有既定的协议.
因此,我们通过一个瓷砖协议:每个重建被分割成不重叠的8192×8192 8192\times 8192瓷砖,然后平均于它们。 Tab. 7报告每种方法的每幅图像LPIPS,时间为 × 4\time 4和 × 8\time 8 升标,反映了 PSNR 和 SSIM 表格的布局.
尽管在数学上不等同于一个单一的前进通道,但这一度量仍然具有信息性,因为LPIPS本身是局部的:它在空间上平均显示的距离,其可接受的字段只跨过几百像素,因此差异仅限于瓦片边界,在这种瓦片大小的面积中可忽略不计的一小部分.

blocks.en:
Tab. 7 reveals three consistent patterns.
Although LPIPS is calibrated on human judgments, and one might therefore expect it to align more closely with our human evaluation than with distortion metrics, at the family level it preserves the PSNR ordering, Hybrid–Classic–Explicit–Implicit, at both scales; in particular, it does not reproduce the Classic-first ranking of the human study.
The agreement with PSNR, however, breaks down within families and at the top: MetricGrids overtakes I-NGP by a clear margin ( 0.312 0.312 vs. 0.368 0.368 at × 4 \times 4 ), providing quantitative support for the analysis of Sec. F , as LPIPS penalizes the nearest-neighbour-like blockiness of I-NGP; similarly, SmartSplat (CR = = 100) surpasses its CR = = 3000 counterpart, and Nearest Neighbour overtakes Bicubic at × 8 \times 8 .
These inversions are consistent with the known tendency of LPIPS to penalize over-smoothing more than aliasing: at × 8 \times 8 , Nearest Neighbour scores better than Bicubic on 7 out of 10 images (e.g., 0.536 0.536 vs. 0.600 0.600 on Venice, 0.833 0.833 vs. 0.936 0.936 on Lynx), despite trailing it by roughly 1 1 dB in PSNR.
The perceptual penalty assigned to a given artifact is, however, strongly content-dependent: on Kidney, the same blocking artifacts cost Nearest Neighbour almost a threefold LPIPS increase over Bicubic ( 0.669 0.669 vs. 0.232 0.232 at × 8 \times 8 ), whereas PSNR reports only a 1.5 1.5 dB gap, showing that per-image LPIPS scores cannot be compared across images and that averages may hide large content-specific effects.
Overall, LPIPS corroborates the central claim of our evaluation: quantitative metrics, including perceptual ones, are informative but not sufficient at gigapixel scale, and rankings among closely matched methods should be interpreted jointly with human judgment.

标签7显示了三种一致的模式。
虽然LPIPS是根据人类的判断来校准的,因此人们可能期望它更接近于人类的评价,而不是扭曲的衡量标准,但在家庭一级,它保留了PSNR命令,Hybrid-Classic-Explict-Implic,在两种尺度上;特别是,它没有复制人类研究的经典第一排名。
然而,与PSNR的协议在家庭内部和最高层有所突破: MetricGrids以明显的比值(0.312 0.312 vs. 0.368 at 4\times 4)超越了I-NGP,为分析Sec.F提供定量支持,因为LPIPS惩罚I-NGP的近邻类阻塞;同样,SmartSplat(CR = = 100)超过其CR = = = = 3000对等,而SmartSplat(CR = = = 3000对等)在8\tims 8上超越了Bicubic.
这些反演与LPIPS的已知倾向是一致的,即惩罚过度流畅而不是别名:在×8\时 8,近邻在10幅图片中7幅的得分优于比库比克(如:威尼斯0.536对0.600 0.600,林克斯0.8330.833对0.936 0.936),尽管在PSNR中以大约1分B的成绩落后.
然而,赋予特定文物的知觉惩罚主要依赖内容:在肾上腺素上,同样的屏蔽文物几乎比比库比克增加了三倍的LPIPS(0.669 0.669 vs. 0.232 0.232 at 8\times 8 ),而PSNR只报告1.5 dB差距,表明每个图像的LPIPS得分无法在图像中进行比较,平均值可能隐藏大量内容特定效果.
总体而言,LPIPS证实了我们评价的核心主张:量化的衡量标准,包括概念性衡量标准,是翔实的,但在千兆像素规模上还不够,在方法上紧密匹配的排名应该与人类判断一起解释。

blocks.en: F Additional motivation for the exclusion of I-NGP in the Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: F. 将I-NGP排除在人类评价之外的其他动机

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Motivation for the exclusion of Instant-NGP from the human evaluation, in favor of the MetricGrids model. We show the × 4 \times 4 super-resolution qualitatives on a crop of Venice, performed by I-NGP (T=24), MetricGrids (T=24) and Nearest Neighbor.

blocks.en: In the main paper, we selected MetricGrids (T=24) as the representative of the Hybrid family despite the marginal PSNR advantage of I-NGP at × 4 \times 4 . We detail here why this PSNR gap is misleading and why I-NGP is unsuitable for the human evaluation under our super-resolution protocol.
blocks.zh: 在主要论文中,我们选择了MetricGrids(T=24)作为混合家族的代表,尽管I-NGP在X 4\times上的边际PSNR优势. 4 (英语). 我们在此详细说明为什么PSNR差距是误导性的,为什么I-NGP不适合根据我们的超分辨率协议进行人类评价.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 10 , I-NGP super-resolved outputs are visually indistinguishable from a nearest-neighbor upsampling of the low-resolution reconstruction.
Each × s \times s block of high-resolution pixels (with s ∈ { 4 , 8 } s\!\in\!\{4,8\} the scale factor) is rendered as a near-constant patch, yielding hard block boundaries and no synthesized high-frequency content.
MetricGrids, by contrast, produces continuous transitions between low-resolution sample positions and recovers a more plausible fine structure, yet with wavy artifacts.
blocks.zh:
如图10所示,I-NGP超级解析产出与近邻对低分辨率重建的抽样无法辨别。
每个xx s\times 高分辨率像素的块(带有s {4, 8} s\!\\\!\%4,8}比例系数)作为近恒定的补丁来渲染,产生硬块边界,没有合成的高频内容.
相比之下,MetricGrids在低分辨率样本位置之间产生连续的过渡,并恢复了一种更可信的精细结构,然而却带有瓦维文物.

blocks.en: The difference lies in how I-NGP and MetricsGrids evaluate a query that falls between the low-resolution samples seen during fitting.
blocks.zh: 其不同之处在于I-NGP和MetricsGrids如何评价一个在安装时看到的低分辨率样本之间的查询。

blocks.en:
In I-NGP, every hash level returns a bilinear interpolation of its cell-corner features, so within each low-resolution cell the encoded feature varies only linearly with sub-pixel position, with the sole non-linearity being a small ReLU MLP applied pointwise.
Since this MLP is supervised only at the low-resolution sample positions, it has no incentive to shape the output between them, and the in-cell reconstruction collapses to a nearly flat plateau that snaps at cell boundaries.
The result is an effectively nearest-neighbor upsampling, hence a shallow bilinear ramp, visually a block of constant colour.
In other words, I-NGP fits the low-resolution samples faithfully but interpolates them with a degenerate, almost-linear function, so it cannot synthesize any detail at the new high-resolution coordinates.
blocks.zh:
在I-NGP中,每个散列电位都会返回其细胞角质特征的双线性插值,因此在每个低分辨率的细胞中,编码的特性仅与子像素位置的线性不同,唯一的非线性是小的ReLU MLP应用点.
由于这种MLP只在低分辨率的样本位置上监督,它没有动力来塑造它们之间的输出,细胞内重建崩溃到一个几乎平坦的高原上,在细胞边界上崩溃.
结果是有效的近邻采样,因此是浅浅的双线斜坡,视线为恒定色块.
换句话说,I-NGP忠实地将低分辨率样本匹配到其中,但用退化的,几乎是线性的功能插上,因此无法在新的高分辨率坐标上合成任何细节.

blocks.en:
MetricGrids avoids this degeneracy by construction.
Beyond the linear grid, it adds elementary metric grids whose features depend non-linearly on the sub-pixel displacement ( ‖ 𝐱 − 𝐱 i ‖ p p \|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}_{i}\|_{p}^{p} , acting as Taylor high-order terms), and a high-order extrapolation decoder that compounds still higher-order terms.
The reconstruction between low-resolution samples is therefore a genuine non-linear function of position rather than an affine ramp, which lets MetricGrids vary the signal inside each cell and recover plausible high-frequency structure.
The same non-linearity is what occasionally overshoots, producing the mild wavy artifacts noted above.
blocks.zh:
MetricGrids通过建筑避免了这种退化.
在线性格网之外,它添加了基本公制格网,其特征非线性地依赖于子像素的位移(Xx − x i → p → mathbf{x}-\ mathbf{x}_{i}\|_{p}^{p},作为泰勒高序词),以及一个高序外推法解码器,使更高序词复合.
因此,低分辨率样品之间的重建是位置的真正非线性功能,而不是一个附属坡道,它让MetricGrids改变每个细胞内的信号,恢复合理的高频结构.
同样的非线性是偶尔过度射击,产生上面提到的温和的瓦维文物。

blocks.en:
High-resolution PSNR rewards I-NGP for exactly reproducing the low-resolution sample values it was fit on, but does not penalize the absence of any synthesized detail between them. Therefore, it fails to capture the perceptual quality that the human evaluation targets.
Accordingly, we exclude I-NGP from the human study and adopt MetricGrids (T=24) as the Hybrid representative for both the × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 settings.
blocks.zh:
高分辨率 PSNR奖励I-NGP完全复制它所搭配的低分辨率样本值,但并不惩罚它们之间缺乏任何综合细节. 因此,它未能掌握人类评价的目标的认知质量。
因此,我们将I-NGP排除在人类研究之外,并采用MetricGrids(T=24)作为混合代表,负责4和8的设置。

blocks.en: G Additional Aggregate Results
blocks.zh: G 额外总结果

blocks.en:
All the aggregate values in the main paper are means over the N = 10 N=10 images of GigaBench .
Since the benchmark spans heterogeneous content, a mean alone does not convey how concentrated the underlying per-image scores are, nor how much of the observed ranking is attributable to a few scenes.
We therefore report, for every method and metric, compounding dispersion statistics across the benchmark images, including the Standard Deviation of the population ( Std ), and ranking statistics such as the Median , the Interquartile Range ( IQR ), the minima and the maxima . Tab. 8 reports the statistics for compression (PSNR, SSIM, CT, IT), and Tab. 9 for super-resolution (PSNR and SSIM at × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 ).
blocks.zh:
主纸中的所有集合值都是N=10 N=10的Giga Bench图像之上的表示.
由于基准跨度各异,因此仅凭一个平均值并不能说明基本成像分数的集中程度,也无法说明观察到的排名有多少可归因于几个场景。
因此,我们报告每一种方法和衡量方法,包括人口标准偏离(Std)在内的基准图像的分散性统计数据以及诸如Median、IQR、minima和maxima等排名统计数据。 Tab.8报告了压缩统计(PSNR、SSIM、CT、IT)和超分辨率统计(PSNR和SSIM at 4\time 4和8\time 8 )。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Dispersion statistics of PSNR, SSIM, Compression Time (CT) and Inference Time (IT) across the benchmark images for the task of Image Compression.

blocks.zh: 表9:PSNR和SSIM在图像超级分辨率×4\time 4和x8\time 8任务的基准图像上的分布统计.

blocks.en:
The dispersion statistics confirm the conclusions of the main paper.
The family-level orderings do not depend on the aggregator: Hybrid–Explicit–Implicit under PSNR and Explicit–Hybrid–Implicit under SSIM hold on the median exactly as on the mean, on both tasks.
The same is true of the competitiveness of classical interpolation, with bicubic staying above every Implicit configuration on the median at both factors ( 24.87 24.87 vs. 22.82 22.82 dB at × 4 \times 4 , 22.90 22.90 vs. 21.51 21.51 dB at × 8 \times 8 ).
Only adjacent entries change places, always by less than σ / N \sigma/\sqrt{N} : MetricGrids ( T = 24 T{=}24 ) and I-NGP ( T = 24 T{=}24 ) swap the first position in compression, as do the T = 22 T{=}22 and T = 24 T{=}24 variants at × 4 \times 4 . We treat these pairs as indistinguishable at N = 10 N=10 .
The one real change is SmartSplat (CR = = 15), which on the median moves above every T = 22 T{=}22 Hybrid configuration it trailed on the mean, in line with the strong SSIM results of Explicit representations.
blocks.zh:
分散性统计数字证实了主要文件的结论。
家庭层面的订单并不取决于聚合器:PSNR下的Hybrit-Explict-Implict 和SSIM下的Hybrid-Implict 中位数与平均数完全相同,都取决于这两项任务。
古典插图的竞争力也是如此,在两个因素中,双曲线都高于中位数的每个隐形构型(24.87 24.87 v 22.82 22.82 dB, at 4\time 4, 22.90 22.90 v 21.51 21.51 dB, at × 8\time 8 )。
只有相邻的条目更改位置,总是小于\\ / N\sigma/\sqrt{N} : MetricGrids (T = 24 T{=}24) 和 I-NGP (T = 24 T{=}24) 互换压缩中的第一个位置, T = 22 T{=}22和 T = 24 T{=}24 变体在 × 4\4 时也是一样. 在N=10 N=10时,我们将这些对子视为不可分.
一个真正的变化是SmartSplate(CR = = 15),在中位数上移动每T = 22 T = 22 混合配置,按照明确表述的强烈SSIM结果,它沿着中间值走.

blocks.en:
The per-image scores are also skewed, and the direction depends on the family.
For all six Hybrid configurations the median sits 1.4 1.4 – 1.9 1.9 dB below the mean; for the three ( 8 , 1024 ) (8,1024) Implicit architectures it sits 0.6 0.6 – 1.6 1.6 dB above it.
The mean thus favours the former and penalises the latter, and the gap between the best method of each family shrinks from 10.9 10.9 to 8.1 8.1 dB when measured on the median.
The cause is the content, not the capacity: every Implicit variant bottoms out at about 13 13 dB ( 0.05 0.05 SSIM) in compression and at both super-resolution factors, whatever its architecture and parameter budget, so a few high-frequency scenes fix their lower tail.
Hybrid representations lose quality on those same scenes, but do not collapse.
blocks.zh:
每幅画的分数也扭曲,方向取决于家庭.
用于所有六个混合组合 中位数为1.4 1.4 – 1.9 dB,低于平均值;对于三个(8, 1024) (8, 1024) 隐形建筑,它坐落在它的上方0.6 – 1.6 1.6 dB.
因此,这一平均值有利于前者,惩罚后者,每个家庭最佳方法之间的差距从10.9 10.9分贝缩小到8.1 8.1分贝。
原因在于内容,而不是容量:每个隐形变体底部在压缩中以约13 13 dB(0.05 SSIM)和两种超分辨率因子,无论它的架构和参数预算如何,因此几个高频场景固定了它们的下尾.
混合表述在上述场景中失去质量,但不会崩溃。

blocks.en: H Additional Human Evaluation scores
blocks.zh: H 人类评价附加分数

blocks.en:
This section reports the complete human-evaluation data summarised by the Elo analysis of the main paper.
For every image and method family, Tab. 10 lists both the win rate and the bootstrapped Elo score (mean and standard deviation over 2000 2000 resamples).
The two are complementary, as the win rate is an unweighted count of how many times the method family has been chosen as the best, and is therefore directly interpretable, whereas Elo additionally rewards victories over stronger opponents and penalises losses to weaker ones, yielding a schedule-aware ranking. Fig. 11 visualises the per-image win rates and Fig. 4 of the main paper reports the corresponding Elo distributions; both are views of the same judgements tabulated in Tab. 10 .
blocks.zh:
本节报告主要文件Elo分析总结的完整的人评价数据。
对于每个图像和方法家族,Tab. 10同时列出了胜率和靴子化的埃洛分数(2000年复标的平均值和标准偏差).
两者互为补充,因为胜率是方法家族被选为最佳方法次数的未加权数,因此是可直接解释的,而埃洛则额外奖励胜过强敌的胜利,对弱敌的亏损进行惩罚,从而产生对时间表的认识排名. 图11可视化了每幅图像的胜率,主要论文图4报告了相应的Elo分布;两者都是在表10中列出的相同判断的观点。

blocks.en: I.1 Training Details
blocks.zh: I.1 培训详情

blocks.en:
For each family, we defined standard training protocols to guarantee convergence. For instance, in compression, Implicit methods are trained for 8 passes over the full image.
As each training step consists of processing a single pixel, and scenes differ in resolution, 8 full image passes map to a different number of steps per scene. Thus, the number of training steps ranges from 30000 to 35000. On the other hand, to achieve convergence, we trained Explicit methods for 10000 training steps, each performed over a full image due to Gaussian Splatting requirements.
In the following paragraphs, we describe the exact training details for each family of methods.
blocks.zh:
对于每个家庭,我们制定了标准的培训规程,以保证趋同。 例如,在压缩方面,对8个传遍整个图像的隐形方法进行了培训。
由于每个训练步骤包括处理一个像素,场景在分辨率上有所不同,8个完整的图像通过地图到每个场景不同的步数. 因此,培训步骤的数量从30000到35000不等。 另一方面,为了实现趋同,我们为10 000个培训步骤训练了明确的方法,由于高斯镀板要求,每个步骤都以完整的形象进行。
在以下各段中,我们描述了每一类方法的确切培训细节。

The number of training steps corresponds to processing every pixel of the image dataset 8 times (about 30000 − 35000 30000-35000 steps) for Compression, while we fix 35000 35000 steps for Super-Resolution.

blocks.en: I.2 Timing Procedure
blocks.zh: I.2 时间安排程序

blocks.en:
All runtimes reported in the main paper are obtained with a single shared protocol, executed on the same machine (RTX 5090, 32GB VRAM, 128GB RAM, CUDA 12.8 , PyTorch 2.9 ) with exclusive access to the GPU and no concurrent workloads.
Timestamps are recorded with time.perf_counter() from the Python standard library; every timestamp is immediately preceded by a torch.cuda.synchronize() call, so that the asynchronous execution of CUDA kernels is never attributed to the wrong phase.
blocks.zh:
主论文中报道的所有运行时间都通过单一共享协议获得,在同一台机器上执行(RTX 5090,32GB VRAM,128GB RAM,CUDA 12.8,PyTorch 2.9),独家访问GPU,没有同时承担的工作量.
时间戳用时间.perf_counter()从Python标准库录制;每一次时间戳前立即有一个火炬.cuda.同步()调用,这样CUDA内核的同步执行永远不会被归咎于错误的阶段.

blocks.en: Compression Time (CT) spans the fitting loop only: it starts after the image has been loaded and the representation has been instantiated, and ends after the last parameter update, including all tile scheduling, host-to-device transfers and gradient accumulation performed within the loop.
blocks.zh: 压缩时间(CT)只跨过适配环:它开始于图像被装入后和表现被即时化,结束于上次参数更新后,包括所有瓦片调度,主机到设备的传输和在循环内进行的梯度积累.

blocks.en: Inference Time (IT) spans the decoding of the full-resolution raster from the fitted representation, including tile scheduling and host-side assembly of the output, and excluding serialisation to disk and metric computation.
blocks.zh: 推论时间(IT)跨越了全分辨率光栅从装配的表示器的解码,包括输出的瓦片排程和主机侧组装,不包括磁盘和度量计算序列化.

blocks.en:
CT and IT are end-to-end wall-clock measurements of the reference implementation of each method. They therefore reflect both the algorithm and its engineering: I-NGP builds on fused CUDA kernels, whereas most of the remaining methods are implemented in PyTorch.
We deliberately report the cost a practitioner incurs with the publicly available code, rather than an idealised measure of algorithmic complexity, and comparisons across families should be read accordingly.
blocks.zh:
CT和IT是对每种方法的参考应用的端到端的壁时测量. 因此,它们既反映了算法及其工程:I-NGP基于已引信的CUDA内核,而其余大部分方法则在PyTorch中实施.
我们有意地报告从业者使用公开的代码所付出的代价,而不是对算法复杂性的一种理想化的衡量,因此应该相应地阅读家庭之间的比较。
